wrongness.why_day_3: the bible's beat 3 (IT KNOWS YOU) comes after the first town is done; a saved game on its third day is the door's honest reading of that. Never on a first load, never two on one screen, never pointed at.

lines.map: Tap anywhere on the map and we walk there. The clock runs while we walk.
lines.town: Tap a building to go in. LEAVE on the phone takes us back out.
lines.camp: We heal quicker at camp. The ring on the phone breaks camp.
